attorneys: Mr. Milton D. Sapiro for petitioners. Mr. Herbert W. Erskine for respondents. Solicitor General Fahy and Mr. Douglas B. Maggs filed a brief on behalf of the Administrator of the Wage and Hour Division, U. S. Dept, of Labor, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
